screens.name: the new-chat home screen with the greeting and the composer
screens.identifier_found: none; the top bar carries only an unlabeled three-line menu glyph and a ghost glyph, and the mid-screen text is a greeting
screens.deciding_evidence: no identifier in any state on the live app; the greeting names the user, not the screen; the drawer opened from here highlights no section (s2), so even the app does not say which section this is. No evaluated transition lands here (the capture has no scroll edges); the harness return edges b10/b18/b19 land here and are not judged.
screens.recommendation: add a visible title to the empty top bar — e.g. "New chat" — and highlight a matching item in the drawer when it is opened from here

screens.name: the side menu opened from the home screen
screens.identifier_found: none; the drawer head is the app's name "Claude" and no drawer item is highlighted
screens.deciding_evidence: live: opening the drawer from the home screen shows "Claude" at the head and no highlighted item among Chats, Projects, Code, Artifacts (a Recents list now follows them). The same drawer opened from Chats/Projects/Code does highlight the current item (s9, s44), so the absence here is specific to arriving from the home screen, which belongs to no listed section.
screens.recommendation: when the drawer is opened from the home screen, show which place the user came from — e.g. a highlighted "New chat" entry — rather than the bare app name

screens.name: the upgrade page scrolled down to the Max plan
screens.identifier_found: none; the "Get more Claude" title has scrolled off the top; visible text is plan cards ("Max", prices, feature bullets), "Get Max plan", "Limits apply", Terms / Privacy Policy
screens.deciding_evidence: live (reached by scrolling the upgrade page, s4): "Get more Claude" scrolls off with the content, no collapsed bar replaces it, and scrolling part-way back does not bring it back — it returns only at the very top. All 52 in-app nodes were opened as marked images and confirmed to show the Claude app's own surface; none was excluded and none was misclassified. The 10 out-of-app nodes (launcher, camera, photo picker, files, Play Store billing, Chrome, permission controller, system settings) and the 19 boundary transitions are not judged; the arrival screens of return edges (s1, s4, s5, s16, s38) are judged as screens.

contains_selected_view appears in the capture (nav_active_state_declared_anywhere: true) on s9 (Chats) and s44 (Code); both highlights are rendered as a faint light grey pill and were confirmed live to move with the section. s2 (drawer from the home screen) declares and shows no selection.

Detector feedback: t20 (s4 -> s28, recorded as a touch on "Everything in Free, plus:") behaves as a scroll of the upgrade page — the user stays on the page and its title leaves the viewport. It is not a structural_same_view_candidate (header lists differ), so it was not promoted; the finding is carried by s28's screen verdict and its scroll-persistence test.

Capture divergences found live (content, not structure; no verdict went provisional because of them): greeting now "Good afternoon, Ally Cooper" (capture "Back at it, Ally Cooper"); drawer now lists "Recents" with two "Untitled" chats; Chats list holds two chats; Add to chat sheet has a Memory row and Web search on; model list shows "Sonnet 5.5"; Capabilities shows memory and sensitive topics on, a Memory files row and extra Tool access options.
Template carries: s16 from s1; s15 from s7; s30, s31, s32, s33, s34 from s29 (by content — same page and title).

Device incident during the tester's own run: an extra Back on the home screen left the app to the launcher, and a following tap landed on the launcher's Google search microphone, briefly opening Google's "Listening…" voice search (not the Claude app). It was dismissed at once with Back and the app relaunched; no permission was granted and nothing was sent.

Persona device incidents: Gopal (Medium_Phone_2) accidentally switched Haptic feedback off with a tap that landed as Settings opened, and switched it back on at once; he also found the Voice settings page already showing a voice called "Glassy", which he did not choose (state left by an earlier session on that phone). Amy (Medium_Phone) saw the keyboard open by itself on the home screen twice and one tap on the plans page X appear to lag. No persona confirmed, bought, granted or deleted anything, and every filter was reset; all four phones were left on the home screen.

Persona sessions: all four personas saw the same 52 in-app marked images, individually; no scroll pairs were shown because the capture holds no scroll transitions. Persona-only issues (23, all on screens judged Sufficient) were translated to Missing View Identifier from each persona's own why/solution; the tester's verdicts are unchanged.
